name: agentkit
description: Reusable agent tooling distributed as Claude Code plugins. The generic units (MCP tools, skills) are the source of truth; the plugins wrap them for one-step install. See ADR #45.

plugins.name: agentkit
plugins.description: Claude Code bundle with enforcement hooks, skills, tools/bounded-run, and the assay + infra-tools MCP toolchains. Hooks require jq, awk, cat, and python3; MCPs require bun and assay. Linux bounded execution additionally requires cgroup v2, a systemd user manager, and a provisioned agent-work.slice.

plugins.name: assay
plugins.description: Gated Lua infra toolkit — Kubernetes, ArgoCD, Vault, Prometheus, GitLab, AWS and more through one read-only/approval-gated tool. Requires the `assay` binary on PATH.

plugins.name: infra-tools
plugins.description: Read-only helm / tofu / git tools for infrastructure investigation, exposed as a typed MCP server. Renders charts, previews plans, and reads git history — never applies or mutates. Requires `bun` on PATH.

plugins.name: agentkit-brain
plugins.description: What the agent knows and how it works: memory (a learning vault) plus taste (conventions)

plugins.name: agentkit-product
plugins.description: Product-model skills: evidence-backed briefs and product review

plugins.name: agentkit-clickup
plugins.description: ClickUp task and sprint lifecycle for teams that track work in ClickUp

plugins.name: agentkit-adversarial-review
plugins.description: Adversarial review: independent refutation lane + evidence records + hard merge gate (explicit opt-in)
